messages:
jordan: AM drop-in — quick update.

jordan: What I did: pushed kernel change to reduce lock hold time (PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/3421). Ran canary with continuous batching enabled for short sequences.

bench-bot: Canary results uploaded: https://bench.internal/one-off/3421
bench-bot: Summary:
```
model: redwood-micro-1
config: cont_batch=true, batch_size=8
p50: 18ms
p95: 56ms
p99: 210ms (+120ms vs baseline)
errors: 0
```

maya: saw the p99 jump, thanks for posting. Is this on CPU or GPU canary?

jordan: GPU canary on g5. Repro steps: `./run_canary --model redwood-micro-1 --seq=16 --cont-batch` — logs attached.

sam: pinging to review PR 3421, taking a look now.

rachel: could KV eviction changes interact? We bumped hot-cache threshold yesterday.

jordan: good call @rachel — I toggled KV eviction off and retested, p99 drops ~60ms. So likely interaction.

bench-bot: quick followup:
```
kv_eviction: on  -> p99 210ms
kv_eviction: off -> p99 150ms
```

maya: Plan: revert the kernel cont-batching flag on prod canary, open joint investigation ticket. @sam can you review the PR and add a test for seq<32?

sam: will review in next hour, adding test now.

rachel: I'll instrument cache traces for next run and paste logs.

jordan: blockers: need infra approval to roll canary back and a CR review. Today: finish logs + coordinate rollback with infra. Thanks :thumbsup:

maya: thx — LMK when rollback is scheduled.

sam: CR done, left comments on 3421.

jordan: ack, fixing comments now.

bench-bot: scheduled follow-up run at 1707123600.

maya: closing loop — ping here once rollback completes.
